---
title: Lobster and Shrimp Soup
id: MAR-0120
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 40
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 1 lobster of 400 g already cooked
- 600 g of shrimp
- 2 anchovy fillets in oil
- 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- 2 shallots
- 2 tablespoons of parsley
- 8 dl of fish stock
- 2 dl of tomato sauce
- 4 slices of country bread
## Method
1. Shell the lobster and cut it into medallions.
2. Shell the claws and cut the meat in half.
3. Clean the shrimp.
4. Peel the shallots and chop them with the anchovy fillets; let them wilt in a saucepan with the oil and parsley over very low heat for 5 minutes, then add the tomato sauce and fish stock and bring to a boil.
5. Add the shrimp, after a minute the lobster, and after another minute turn off the heat.
6. Meanwhile toast the bread in the oven at 220 °C for 5 minutes and place in shallow bowls; distribute the shellfish, pour the broth over and serve.
